Holes in air bladder impair pump function. Brand new pump, installed on a new 5 gallon Primo water jug. Dispenses less than 1oz of water for each push of the pump, or about 20 full pushes to fill a 16.9oz water bottle. Pump is wheezing and whistling the whole time. Junk as a water pump and dispenser. Good for hand / wrist exercise though.
UPDATE: I found and fixed the problem. The air bladder inside the pump had about 10 small evenly-spaced cuts around the bottom. I assume this was done at the factory as a relief mechanism so that the air bladder wouldn't burst with rigorous pumping. But this also caused the pump to fail for lack of vacuum and was the cause of the wheezing sound and the extra air coming from the top around the blue plunger and the white body. It had to got to the point where I would have to pump the thing 50 times to fill up a 1 liter water bottle. My fix was to use a few narrow strips from a roll of Tegaderm (thin flexible stretchy tape) to seal those slits in the air bladder. Now I can fill a 1 liter water bottle with about 5 pumps. Upgraded rating from 1 star to 2 stars because it can be fixed, but still, this is should be something checked at the factory

Arrived Damaged : liquid in hub locker!. Unfortunately Amazon in their wisdom (cough, cough) decided to ship the snowsuit in a vinyl bag with holes in it! There was no other bag to protect the snowsuit inside vinyl bag with all the holes. This is what happened: Arrived in hub locker. It was the very top locker. Opened it & pulled the pkg out getting a very wet & nasty surprise at the same time. My senses were assaulted. Smells like tea tree oil. Feels like conditioner or lotion. I can’t understand how the delivery person a) didn’t smell that mess when they shoved the pkg in b) didn’t see the mess when they shoved it in - tho if they were short I guess that would explain it bc I’m 5’10” & I didn’t see it until the pkg was in my hands. The locker was up high & dark, but I could smell it the minute I walked into the hub locker room. I happen to be extremely allergic to tea tree oil. It’s made from mellaleuca trees which grow all over southwest Florida where I was raised. Tho native to Australia they were used to help drain the swamps of Florida generations ago bc they soak up so much water. It has a very distinct smell & unfortunately is frequently used as a “carrier oil” for other oils & body lotions, shampoos, conditioners, etc., so I have to be hyper-vigilant to avoid exposure. Instead- Last night I got to suck down Benadryl & pray my throat didn’t close while keeping my epi-pens handy. The liquid went through the holes & onto the snowsuit as you can clearly see in the pictures. So I guess the suit is waterproof. Looks true to size. Elastic appears stretchy. I’m super annoyed that this arrived in this condition & could have easily been avoided by amazon properly wrapping it to avoid the elements whatever they may be

Useless under 40 degrees.. Useless under 40 degrees unless you’re just running to the mailbox & back & don’t mind freezing during that jog. Seems to me like they used a too large needle with the thread in mine bc it’s like the air comes through every single hole the thread is in that they used for decoration/insulation to give it a quilted effect. With cotton fabrics you wash it & the material will shrink around the thread & you don’t have the air coming through the too large holes made by the needle. I usually stick with the non-quilted versions of non-cotton coats fit this reason. It looks nice, but it does not keep me warm in northern Colorado where we dip into negative temps & have crazy high winds. I was not impressed with it. Got it in tye try before you buy program without realizing I would have to pay for bags to return the items I tried or that I would have to drop them off at ups. I’m disabled. I don’t drive. So fun to pay for taxis to return stuff when Amazon has a flipping hub at my apt complex. Why can’t they make returns simpler? Delivered to the hub & I should be able to return it to the hub imo. Really ticks me off I don’t get anything delivered to my door anymore since moving to an apt. As a disabled person it’s a massive pain in my tush. Every step is agony & the stuff weighs more than I am supposed to lift. It’s a long walk when you’re in chronic pain. Should have sent it back with the rest bc now I’ll have to pay for another $3 bag & taxis, but I wanted to try it in colder weather since it matched the color of my boots. My bad. Useless in cold weather. The other issue I noticed was I tried 3 Columbia jackets in the same size (xl) bc I like to wear fleece & layers under my coats due to the temps here & the difference in sizing was ridiculous. This was a true xl while the other two were not. Easily managed camisole, T-shirt, & long sleeved, very thick, fleece shirt under it. Just does not keep you warm on its own. It’s a spring jacket imo not winter. It has a fuzzy fur inside & I have coke to prefer fleece lined jackets bc I have service dogs & their fur is easier to get off flat fleece than fluffy fur

I wire regular athletic socks today, but will try them again with wool socks later. Either way they are one of the most comfy boots I have ever worn. The cushioning is magnificent. I got the baby blue color for around $40 with tax which is a great deal imo. The only big issue is I purchased them for winter walks with my dogs so they won’t work for their intended purposes. My dilemma is whether to keep them for spring boots. The light color means they will get dirty fast so idk. I just know they are crazy comfy & feel wonderful on my feet. I might try them with some fleece socks too & probably just spray them with boot waterproofing. They are like a canvas tennis shoe. The material they are made out of. So super light which I love due to my disabilities, but I don’t think I’ll be wearing these in the back country walks bc of the color I picked. Which I picked solely based on the price. I’m cost effective not cheap lol. I admit when I got them from the amazon locker they were so incredibly light that I expected garbage. While these are very light they are also an excellent walking boot imo tho if you need them to be waterproofed good luck bc mine are not. If you are sticking to plowed roads & sidewalks & avoid big drifts of snow & wear a thick wool sock these will probably work very well if you’re looking for a comfy hiking boot. The length of time is excellent too as it is down between my calves and my ankles. I love the color. It was the deciding factor in my choosing this robe in the first place. I’ll be sad to see it go as it really is an excellent robe if it didn’t have the bad seams in 2 places and the Bobbin vomit thread issues. It’s the kind of robe you will want to snuggle and cuddle into and with someone. Two people will easily fit in this one! I’m just afraid that if I buy the s/m that the arms will not be long enough and the robe length will be shorter too. I also hate that most s/m robe belts hit me under my breasts instead of at my natural waist and the pockets are located under each breast instead of along my hips. Worked great!. took this on Vacation as a beach cover-up! Worked great!

Take a big gamble on the size.. I ordered 3 pairs at the same time and none of them are the same size. I gave one to my niece who is a size 4 and the other two are wearable but not perfect. Also, holes wear through in the crotch very quickly. They are soft but you can't rely on sizing

SHOES THAT FIT!!!. Fit could be better with a half size smaller. Feeling great on my feet. Easy to walk in, cooler than tennis shoes
Dont fit!. Seams on top of shoe irritation to big toe

Great for swear wicking & UV protection. I use Buffs in the summer to wick swear away from my head, keep ticks off of my hair, and provide UV protection for my head, neck, face, etc while hiking and running. They can also go under a hat to keep it clean. I love these things, I have several brands but BUFF is UPF50 which is hard to beat!

Nice hat, may buy another. This is a lovely very lightweight hat, the cap portion is thin and stretchy and the brim is stiff, a bit heavy compared to the rest of the hat but feels comfortable. Less like a traditional baseball hat, more like a brim with a stretchy fabric that goes around your head. Good design.

I got the slightly obnoxious high viz yellow to wear while road running and would consider getting another in a more attractive color for wearing all the time! It is definately visible though!

Love these so much I got 2 pairs. Very comfortable, light weight, quick drying, slightly stretchy. I like to wear these around town, to do yoga, and to hike in the sun & heat. I feel even cooler than I would wearing shorts
Nicely made, comfortable. These are very pretty and comfortable. The leg opening felt tight at first but stretched a bit with wear

Great for hiking. I wore this on a 7 mile hike up and down a mountain in the spring in the south - it was very comfortable, I felt cool and stayed dry. I did cut the stitches between the thumb hole and the hem - they just hold the seam closed, the seam itself is sewn separately so this enlarges the opening without damaging the seam. I would purchase another

Why no gusset?. Warm and mosture wicking but the lack of a gusset is a strange choice - they ride up my but as a result.

I like the wide elastic band and infinity drawstring. They fit low on my hips but stay up well. The matte fabric is nice. These are good in the mid 20s to mid 30s
Great though hat. Beautiful hat, bright white color, great reflective details. My hair fits well through the back, the size adjuster is easy to use. Very comfortable
Not fleece. These pants are ok but they are not made from fleece, they are a soft slippery knit material. Not warm . Outside fabric already looks damaged. I would not buy again

good winter walking shoe. These are comfortable sneaker type shoes for walking outdoors in cool weather. Although they are not waterproof, they do keep out moisture if you step into a shallow puddle or walk through wet grass, etc. The upper is very soft and flexible, not stiff at all. They are a bit wide and roomy, and I have narrow feet, but I can wear them very comfortably if I tighten the laces. No issue there. I chose to add a cushioned insert, there is definitely enough space for most insoles. The shoes themselves have a pretty minimal insole, not a ton of arch support or cushion. They have nice treds on the outside but it looks like they would wear down since they aren't that deep

Good for running in mild temps. I am 5'1" 105 lbs and ordered an xs short. Thank you under armour for selling petite sizes!! They fit great, next to skin but not restrictive. These are lightweight leggings for warm weather, we still have some 50s + 60s days and these are perfect. No issues with chaffing or discomfort, at least not at a 5k distance. Not see through

Cheaply made, loose threads, thin & scratchy. Title says it all, really. It's thin, it's a very loose knit, there are loose threads everywhere... it's on the wider side so it won't stay up over your nose or keep your neck warm, although wearing it as a hood, around your head, or as balakava is ok. It's more expensive than and less nice than similar products from other brands. Washing it did make it a bit softer, but I have no idea how a reputable brand that is so popular can also be so cheap and poorly made
Nice running socks. These socks are slick to prevent blisters when running. They fit great (woman's size 7 shoe) and have some cushion but are overall very thin. Very comfortable

Good gloves!. I just got these, but they seem very well made and sturdy. Outdoor Research is an excellent company and I have three other items from them, all of which are well made.

I measured my hands and compared to the company's size chart before ordering. They fit great. They work well with my phone.

These are very thick gloves - heavyweight, as it says. The packaging clarifies that they are designed for 20-40F weather and can be used as a liner.

I got the cacao color which in person is a warm brownish purple/plum. It's a nice color but I bought them for warmth and fit

My 3rd + 4th sets of TSLA leggins. I am 5'1" and 105lbs, 24" waist 33" hips, ordered an XS.

This fit more tightly than my other pair of leggings with a pocket at the waist rather than on the leg, kind of like a compression legging, but both styles are very comfortable. They smelled a little weird out of the bag so I threw them in the wash/dry and tried them on - good fit. They are more what I would call a mid rise, coming 2.5" below my true waist. Still a comfortable rise for me. I also own a pair of TSLA XS black fleece leggings. All four leggings are squat proof and pass a flash photo test (that is, you can't see my underwear if I take a photo with the flash). I keep coming back to this brand because it's so hard to find nice, affordable leggings especially in small sizes. I wore these leggings on two 1.5 mile long walks in the heat and stayed comfortable, so I would say they are moisture wicking and good to work out in. Whether or not they are good for runs probably depends on how they fit you as you really do not want to run in leggings if there is any chaffing at all or any other fit issue. They do have flat seams that are good for running

Pretty and comfortable. I am 5'1" 105lbs, the xs skort is comfortable, flattering, and just the right length. The shorts under are pretty short (kind of like hot pants) so not super modest but fine for normal activities where the skirt covers you most of the time. Quick dry type fabric. Basically it's well made and what I expected
Lightweight but not sturdy. Definitely comfortable and light weight but it feels a little flimsy. Worried about durability
Nice gift. Got this to replace my boyfriend's old minimalist wallet that was failing apart. Looks and feels nice and it holds all his stuff!

Nice watch, good gift. Got this for my boyfriend for Christmas, he loves it. In person you can really see the quality and attention to detail. The face has an inner and outer circle that look great when the light hits them
Ok but not great. These earrings have a weird finish that is smooth/shiny in some areas and rough/matte in others. They don't irritate my ears and are light weight but the finish seems low quality

Runs large but seems well made. I have a 24" waist, ordered an xxs. They are big but i can make them work with the included belt. They are warm and seem well constructed. Due to being so big be they make a weird noise when I walk and the legs rub together. I bought these for field work on cold, damp days. I wish they sold smaller sizes. Calling pants with a 28" waist extra extra small is a little ridiculous.

I wore these into a pool of water while doing fieldwork in 40F weather. The water rolled right off the outer layer, the fleece got wet (obviously, these are pants not waders) but stayed warm and dried fast. I'm really glad to have these and I will be wearing them on future expeditions. I think they would also be good for hiking in wet, cold weather
pretty watch, well made. I love this watch and wear it often, absolutely no issues, it's very pretty!
good hat!. There is a draw string to adjust fit, held up fine in the washer (air dried), pretty hat with good sun protection
Ran a little too big for me (32A/B). Ran a little large on me, I may need a smaller size (32A/B) but none is available. Otherwise the bra is fine, it's just big on me

Good fit, not high rise, comfortable. They fit like normal thongs and are comfortable, they do have seams but they don't show under my leggings so I don't mind. They were comfortable and dry on my 3 mile run

and it's perfect for that. I bought this watch to wear to an interview, and it's perfect for that. Very small and dainty on my wrist, but still easy to read at a glance. What's that smell?. Lovely items, but they smelled strongly of chemicals right out of the package. I washed on delicate cycle with cold water and line dried, that got rid of the smell

Awesome product! Hood, scarf, and face mask in one!. I am a petite woman, and this product fit me very well. Based on some of the other reviews, I was worried that it would be too big. It fits just right, and I think it would fit most people well. The trick is not to pull the hood too far forward unless you are using the drawstring to keep your face warm. The face mask potion can be held over your nose or pushed under the chin, making it versatile. It's made from a soft, warm fleece. In extreme windchill situations it might not be warm though - but I don't expect wind-proofing from a $10 product. It could probably be worn under another hood for extra warmth and wind resistance.

I have night classes, so I can't avoid long chilly walks. I think this product will help keep me warm and make my walks a lot more comfortable. Thanks!

Great bag!. I had no idea the bag would be so lightweight - I guess seeing is really believing. The thin lightweight material is fantastic and holds all my heavy stuff with ease. The color is lovely as well
